hooks.command: node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; if (p.includes('.env') && !p.includes('.env.example')) { console.error(JSON.stringify({ block: true, message: 'Editing production .env secrets directly is forbidden by safety hook.' })); process.exit(2); }"

node -e "const p = process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH || ''; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (p.endsWith('.ts') || p.endsWith('.tsx')) { try { execSync('npx @biomejs/biome format --write ' + JSON.stringify(p), { stdio: 'ignore', cwd: './frontend' }); } catch(e){} } else if (p.endsWith('.py')) { try { execSync('ruff format ' + JSON.stringify(p), { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch(e){} }"
